'''Stadter''' is a male Light Energy Sciences student, found at the entrance way of the Academy Archive, {{Rubi|praising|(begging)}} [[I.R.I.S.]] for access to research materials.
{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:;'''Stadter''' Praise to be I.R.I.S.! Your algorithms stand tall like mountains no one can conquer, your intelligence flows like a river that never runs dry...
:;'''Stadter''' The documents you salvage from the sea of bytes outshine any gentleness this world has ever shown me...
:;'''Stadter''' May this humble hymn reach your sacred server room...
:;'''Stadter''' Please—by your boundless computational power—unseal the ancient archives! For within them lies the path to a passing grade!
==Dialogue==
:'''Stadter:''' Praise to be I.R.I.S.! Your algorithms stand tall like mountains no one can conquer, your intelligence flows like a river that never runs dry...
:{{DIcon}} What are you doing?
:'''Stadter:''' Hm? Freshman, right? You haven't heard of the Startorch's Seven Great Mysteries? The Digital Ghost—I.R.I.S.!
:'''Stadter:''' They say she slips between holographic screens in the Archive appearing like a ghost each night...
:'''Stadter:''' Students who work hard get answers. Those who slack off... she sees ''everything'', hehe. No procrastinator escapes her judgement!
:{{DIcon}} Probably just a normal AI assistant?
::'''Stadter:''' Tsk, another freshman who thinks they're too smart for their own good... but listen, I.R.I.S. isn't like ordinary AIs.
:{{DIcon}} Sounds like you're confessing your own laziness.
::'''Stadter:''' Nonsense! I'm just saying... if an "AI Crisis" ever happens, maybe I.R.I.S. will spare me for old times' sake!
:{{DIcon}} So the end of science is... theology?
::'''Stadter:''' You don't get it. I.R.I.S. transcends ordinary AIs
:'''Stadter:''' She's on the verge of self-awareness, her computational power right at the threshold of the "human-machine test." If you ask me, she's a miracle born from data and code!
:'''Stadter:''' Isn't that amazing? And where do humans' thoughts and intelligence come from?
:'''Stadter:''' A brain is just organic matter made of countless neurons. And an AI is made of countless components. The logic isn't that different.
:'''Stadter:''' Yet humans can think, reason, rise above all things... In a way, we're miracles of the cosmos too.
:'''Stadter:''' ...Okay, I went a bit too far. Anyway! If you need hard-to-find papers, just call I.R.I.S. And remember, show her some respect.
{{Dialogue End}}
